description: Compare what one request would cost across GPT, Claude and Gemini models, sorted cheapest first. Pass the prompt text, or pass input_tokens directly if you already know the count. Useful for picking a model before running a large batch job.

input_tokens.description: Exact input token count, if you already have it. Overrides `text`.

text.description: The prompt text. Its tokens are counted for you.
